title: Just ok.
text: Just ok.. Huge tapestry! Very light and silky fabric. The design is just printed on it, it’s not embroidered or anything. But it does look like product that was advertised. The stitching around the border is a cheap, simple stitch that looks clumsy. This is fine for a teenager but lacks elegance and quality.
